results.title: UPPSC PCS 2026: Last date to apply tomorrow; check how to apply, eligibility, application fee and other details
results.description: The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission will close applications for PCS 2026 on July 27. Interested candidates must apply online through the official UPPSC website before this date. This examination recruits for Group A and Group B administrative posts across Uttar Pradesh. The notification released on June 25 details eligibility, application, and selection stages. Approximately 500 vacancies are available for various key government positions.

results.title: Jaaved Jaaferi explains why Bollywood is bringing back big ensemble cast films like 'Dhamaal 4'
results.description: Bollywood is witnessing a growing trend of films with large ensemble casts aimed at appealing to a wide range of viewers. 'Dhamaal 4' exemplifies this shift by combining popular returning actors with fresh talent. This comedy continues to entertain families at theaters, even in its third week, generating substantial box office success with over 140 crore rupees while offering a clean comedic experience that resonates with weekend audiences.
